info.name: AdmitFlow - WhatsApp final delivery check
info.description: Run health first, then send hello_world once. HTTP 200 on send means accepted, not delivered. Delivery must be confirmed on the handset or by a signed status webhook. Credentials are placeholders; use local Postman environment values.

request.description: Read health_status.can_send_message and each entity's errors. BLOCKED is a Meta-side restriction. The collection runner stops here when health reports BLOCKED.

exec: pm.test('Meta does not report sending blocked', function () { pm.expect(health).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(health.can_send_message).not.to.eql('BLOCKED'); });

request.description: Sends one message to the configured test recipient. Use digits with country code and verify that the recipient is on this app's test allow-list. A returned message id is submission evidence only. Inspect the delivery-status webhook for sent/delivered/failed and any error codes.

exec: pm.test('Meta accepted submission (not proof of delivery)', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); var responseBody = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(responseBody.messages).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(responseBody.messages[0].id).to.be.a('string'); });
